context:
Global assets (SYSTEM-ENGINEERING / ~/.config/opencode) and project assets (PROJECTS/

/.opencode) can define agents, commands and skills with colliding names. OpenCode deep-merges configs and lets the project override the global scope. Master System gates must never be degraded by a project or domain pack. Restrictions: do not mix global and project agents; no silent shadowing.
problem: What precedence and naming rules prevent silent shadowing, collisions and gate degradation across scopes?

options_considered.option: Documented precedence + prefixed naming + collision check

decision: Adopt explicit precedence and naming. Precedence for OpenCode config: built-in < GLOBAL < PROJECT < LOCAL (env). For the Master System: CORE < DOMAIN packs < PROJECT, strictly additive, so gates are never weakened. Names: GLOBAL agents/commands/skills are unprefixed (reviewer); PROJECT assets are prefixed with the project slug (<slug>-reviewer). `se validate` runs a collision check that reports any project asset shadowing a global one unless it is an explicit, documented override.
reason: It gives predictable resolution, keeps global and project agents separate (restriction 3), prevents silent shadowing, and hard-guards gate non-degradation (restriction 7).
consequences: NAMING_CONVENTIONS.md and PRECEDENCE_RULES.md define the rules. se validate implements the collision check. Project assets already prefixed with their slug conform; every project must follow.
